title: Danish Bible (Old Testament 1871, New Testament 1907) in the original orthography, one verse per line
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/da/DaOT1871NT1907/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module DaOT1871NT1907). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 4,122,807 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'danish') gives 3,698,960 characters.
